description: Unofficial Lancer fan-art animated companion inspired by Deltarune. The blue spade hood, white lower face and black round torso are rendered in a smooth, fully covered chibi style. Original motions include balancing and catching a paper crown, gently lifting an empty paper box, opening a gap between two foam blocks for a paper dot, waddling in three directions and a small squat-hop. All props are soft nonfunctional models. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
